title: engines.engine_field_acked
description: WS-433 / FIND-305 — fired by `cwos-frame.js ack-field` once per low-confidence contract field the founder individually acknowledges during /engine pre-flight. The confirm gate refuses an engine_intent_recorded whose prompted fields lack a matching ack (scoped to acks emitted after the last recorded intent for the engine). Single-field-per-event is enforced at emit time — a batched multi-field ack is rejected — making the prose-forbidden 4-question form structurally unconfirmable (DEC-029 / feedback_airtight_via_hooks).

engine.description: Specialized engine name the pre-flight is for (eng-engine, design-audit, etc.)

field.description: The single contract field this ack covers. Exactly one per event — batching is rejected at emit.

composed_by.description: ALTERATION-5 provenance — the gate is deterministic, not AI-narrated
